Who We Are

Sri Lanka's Favourite
Surf & Cafe

Nestled on the sun-drenched shores of Dewata Beach, Galle, Nalaka Surf and Cafe is the perfect place to begin your surfing adventure — or take it to the next level. Run by a passionate couple, our team of certified instructors brings years of experience and endless stoke to every session.

After a great surf, unwind at our beachfront Café & Restaurant — serving delicious food, fresh seafood, and top-quality European-style coffee with a jaw-dropping ocean view.

Surf Tours

Multi-day adventures exploring the best surf destinations across Sri Lanka's stunning south coast. Perfect for committed surfers wanting the full experience.

  • ✓ 2–5 day itineraries
  • ✓ Accommodation arranged
  • ✓ All surf spots mapped
